ui.whole.title: Whole-song accompaniment / My arrangement
ui.whole.hint: Choose a complete arrangement and compare it at the same position. Melody, practice volumes, speed and transpose stay unchanged. Copy a suggestion to My arrangement to edit it; automatic suggestions never overwrite your corrections.
ui.whole.description.stable: Clear downbeats and root bass notes to help establish the rhythm.
ui.whole.description.flowing: Arpeggios with connected inversions for flowing phrases.
ui.whole.description.sparse: Short chords and bass on each measure's first beat, with space on the remaining beats.
ui.whole.name: Name
ui.whole.merge_tip: Only adjacent intervals can be merged. The merged interval keeps the first interval's root, quality, inversion and pattern.
ui.whole.add: Add an interval in a gap
ui.whole.merge_adjacent: Select an interval adjacent to the next one; separated intervals cannot be merged.
ui.whole.no_gap: There is no gap. Delete or shorten an interval before adding one.
ui.whole.generation_failed: Whole-song options could not be generated. Check the mode, meter and melody diagnostics. My arrangement is unchanged.
ui.whole.replace_draft: This replaces the current My arrangement draft. Automatic options and the confirmed project arrangement stay unchanged. Continue?
messages.storage.invalid_audio_source: Invalid source audio or alignment: check duration, selected range, note indexes, finite seconds, monotonic tick mapping and lyric lengths.
cli.whole_song_check: Check whole-song options, My arrangement and persistence through the actual UI
messages.storage.invalid_generated_notat: The generatedNotation layout flag must be a boolean.
